Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the data to be verified, such as billing street.

TextValue.name: Text Value
TextValue.definition: Value of the data expressed in text form.

BinaryValue.name: Binary Value
BinaryValue.definition: Value of the data expressed in BASE-64 encoded binary form.

HexadecimalBinaryValue.name: Hexadecimal Binary Value
HexadecimalBinaryValue.definition: Value of the data expressed in hexadecimal encoded binary form.

DateTime.name: Date Time
DateTime.definition: Date and time when the verification was performed.

ValidityEndDate.name: Validity End Date
ValidityEndDate.definition: Contains end date of the verification that has been performed.

ValidityEndTime.name: Validity End Time
ValidityEndTime.definition: Contains end time of the verification that has been performed.
